# Open Weight Models

> Independent, source-first technical reference for open-weight AI models, licenses, hardware, inference, deployment and European deployment considerations.

Canonical site: https://openweightmodels.eu/
Updated: 2026-10-01

## Scope

Open Weight Models tracks 64 open-weight model profiles. The registry currently contains 32 Gold-standard Model Passports with full technical/license/deployment review and 32 current source-verified profiles for newer or additional releases.

“Open weight” describes access to trained model parameters. It does not automatically mean Open Source AI, unrestricted commercial use, GDPR compliance, EU data residency, or an AI Act exemption.

Provider origin is recorded separately from deployment location and data residency. A provider-country flag identifies the primary model-publishing organization; it is not a claim about training-data origin, inference location, user location, or where prompts and documents are processed.

## Evidence rules

1. Prefer primary publisher model cards, official repositories and official license text.
2. Keep model facts, license facts, deployment facts and provider-origin metadata separate.
3. Treat hardware classes as deployment guidance, not guaranteed minimum requirements.
4. Do not turn benchmark results into an overall model-quality ranking.
5. Record a verification date and link the primary source.
6. For EU deployment, assess the complete data path: inference, RAG, embeddings, logging, monitoring, backups and subprocessors.
7. “EU/EEA self-hosting possible” is a technical deployment property, not a GDPR or AI Act compliance badge.

## Legal and regulatory note

OpenWeightModels provides technical comparison and provenance, not legal advice. Model-specific official sources, applicable law and organization-specific legal review remain authoritative.
